title: Green photoluminescent carbon dots: sensitive and selective optical detection of aclonifen pesticide
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00594A, Paper
Mehrdad Mirzaei, Ardeshir Shokrollahi, Saeed Yousefinejad, Mehrorang Ghaedi
This research developed an innovative fluorescent sensor using green and aqua-soluble carbon dots (CDs) to detect the pesticide aclonifen (AFN) in agricultural samples.
